article.title: Unexploded ordnances left by Israel in Gaza pose a constant danger to Palestinians
article.author: Khuloud Sulaiman
article.content: In addition to the unrelenting bombardment, Palestinians in Gaza are at risk of losing their lives and limbs through the unexploded ordnances that the Israeli army leaves behind.
source_folders: 06_左派ニュース・社会主義戦略
